328486.name: Chabad of Dumbo
328486.note: Its own About page (in Firecrawl's search index, Nov 10 2026): 'Esther and Rabbi Avrom Chakoff moved to Dumbo in 2005 to open Chabad of Dumbo'. The chabad.org listing went up Dec 19 2005. Its chabad.org listing went up 2005-12-19, so it existed by then. Director: Avrom Tov Chakoff.

357153.name: Chabad of Long Island City
357153.note: Chabad.org News ('Industrial Turns Residential in Long Island City, and Jewish Life Thrives'): 'Rabbi Zev and Rivka Wineberg moved there in 2006, starting the JCC-Chabad of Long Island City/Astoria.' The chabad.org listing went up Feb 7 2006. (His LinkedIn dates 'Chabad of West Queens', which they founded, from Dec 2003.) The Queens Chronicle (on CrownHeights.info, 2 Oct 2011): 'The Winebergs moved to LIC about four years ago' (about 2007). But its chabad.org listing went up Feb 7 2006, so it existed (at least on paper) by then; the count back does not fit, so only the bound is kept.

354284.name: Chabad-Sutton
354284.note: Its own pages (in Firecrawl's search index, Nov 10 2026): About and Leadership: 'Sutton Place Chabad was founded in 2005 as a division of Chabad of Midtown'; the home page: 'Founded in 2006 and led by Rabbi Shmuel and Raizy Metzger'. Medium: its pages differ by a year; the chabad.org listing went up Jan 30 2006. Its chabad.org listing went up 2006-01-30, so it existed by then. Director: Shmuel Metzger.

449325.name: Chabad Israel Center
449325.note: Its own site (blog bio, read through WebFetch, Nov 10 2026): Rabbi Uriel Vigler 'has been directing the Chabad Israel Center of the Upper East Side of Manhattan together with his wife Shevy since 2005.' Medium: when its directors began, not a founding statement; the chabad.org listing went up Nov 27 2006. Its chabad.org listing went up 2006-11-27, so it existed by then. Director: Uriel Vigler.

567022.name: Chabad of Putnam
567022.note: Its own Welcome page (read through WebFetch, Nov 10 2026): 'The Chabad Jewish Center of Putnam County, located in the Hamlet of Carmel, was founded in 2007'. The chabad.org listing went up Oct 10 2007. Its chabad.org listing went up 2007-10-10, so it existed by then. Director: Avi Korer.

541851.name: Chabad at Union - The Rohr Jewish Student Center
541851.note: Rabbi Shmuly Rubin's LinkedIn has him at 'Chabad at Union College' from Sept 2007; the chabad.org listing went up July 20 2007. Medium: a self-written profile and a listing in the same year. Its chabad.org listing went up 2007-07-20, so it existed by then. Director: Shmuly Rubin.
